sources.version: Pang et al. 2024 single-center cohort and systematic review
sources.readScope: Complete 11-page PDF accessed; abstract, methods, 35-patient cohort table, systematic-review table, operative distribution, outcomes and limitations read.

sources.version: Napolitano et al. 2023 case report and systematic review
sources.readScope: Accessible full article methods, study-selection, reconstructed pathways, results and limitations read; individual underlying case papers were not all opened.
Methods and operative sequence, cohort/outcome table, discussion, limitations and figure legends read; publisher-final tables and source figure images remain unverified.

sources.version: Lumbiganon et al. 2023 original indexed abstract
sources.readScope: Complete indexed abstract read: 42 treated, 23 single-stage and 12 two-stage patients, exact infection, dehiscence, reoperation, fever, no-complication and length-of-stay results; full article and adjusted tables unavailable.

sources.version: Suleiman et al. 2024 original indexed abstract
sources.readScope: Complete abstract read: 18 operations, 13 patients presenting with necrosis and nine each receiving primary closure or staged scrotal reconstruction; no abstract success rate.

sources.version: Kang et al. 2026 original indexed abstract
sources.readScope: Complete abstract read: 11-patient Matriderm/STSG/NPWT protocol, minus-125-mmHg setting, graft-take, complications, satisfaction and follow-up; full methods and figures unavailable.

sources.version: Cormio et al. 2014 penile MRI case report
sources.readScope: Complete case report and MRI figures/captions accessed; single-patient mapping and differential-diagnosis role read without extrapolating diagnostic accuracy.

sources.version: Marín-Martínez et al. 2023 original indexed abstract
sources.readScope: Complete indexed abstract read for two-center algorithm and reported aesthetic/functional framing; methods, denominators, tables and figures remain unavailable.
Recovery disposition and already documented Murányi/scrotal-flap source boundaries reused by exact attribution; no prior review was promoted to complete source access.

pages.readScope: Complete current MDX, frontmatter, indication, preoperative, reconstruction, operative sequence, outcomes, complication, nonoperative and principles sections, every table and all 16 references; no local imported clinical dataset, figure or video.

coverage.evaluation: Clinical diagnosis, urgent features and selective MRI role read; MRI diagnostic performance and complete malignancy workup evidence remain open.
coverage.treatment: Excision, primary closure, flap, staged and graft pathways preserved without claiming one universal operation or comparative winner.
coverage.numbers: Pang, Murányi, Lumbiganon, Suleiman and Kang denominators/outcomes reconciled at accessed source scope; other series remain pending.
coverage.doseDeviceSafety: Kang's reported NPWT setting retained as one protocol; no universal device setting or steroid regimen is asserted.
coverage.anatomyTechnique: Murányi sequence and inverted-V intent preserved as source-specific teaching; full figures and several operative papers remain unread.
coverage.followUp: Questionnaire response and Kang median follow-up separated from total cohorts; long-term comparative function and recurrence remain unresolved.
coverage.importedDataFigures: No local imported clinical data, figure or video; Cormio source MRI figures/captions were inspected, other source figures remain open.
coverage.references: All 15 inherited references retained, one penile MRI case report added and the breast-imaging citation labeled non-penile; full-source reading remains selective.
coverage.currency: 2024 cohort/review and 2026 resurfacing abstract checked; no new OpenEvidence query and no formal guideline identified.

claimChecks.claim: Paraffinoma universally requires definitive complete excision and one preferred reconstruction
claimChecks.locator: Pang cohort/systematic review and Napolitano review methods/results/limitations
claimChecks.note: Selected symptomatic cohorts frequently underwent surgery, but management and coverage are individualized and no guideline or comparative trial establishes one universal operation.

claimChecks.claim: Eighteen of 35 Pang patients represent a 51% complication-driven reoperation rate
claimChecks.note: The count includes planned/staged and unplanned multiple procedures and is no longer labeled solely as reoperation.

claimChecks.claim: Penile MRI diagnoses paraffinoma, maps every structure and excludes malignancy
claimChecks.locator: Single case report narrative and MRI figures
claimChecks.note: MRI is framed as selective mapping/differential support; one case does not establish diagnostic accuracy or cancer exclusion.

claimChecks.claim: Murányi showed 90% success and preserved intercourse/erectile function in all 49 patients
claimChecks.note: Twenty-seven of 30 respondents met the authors' success definition; all 30 respondents reported intercourse ability and two reported erectile dysfunction.

claimChecks.claim: Two-stage scrotal reconstruction has definitively fewer wound complications and the inverted-V design prevents necrosis
claimChecks.locator: Lumbiganon abstract comparative results and Murányi technique/outcomes
claimChecks.note: Aggregate and fever differences were reported, but infection/dehiscence/reoperation estimates were imprecise; the geometry is an intended tension strategy and marginal necrosis still occurred.

claimChecks.claim: Kang proves NPWT-assisted STSG is a validated equivalent alternative and Suleiman reported 72.2% postoperative necrosis
claimChecks.note: Kang is an 11-patient single-arm protocol; Suleiman's 13/18 necrosis was present at presentation, not a postoperative event.

claimChecks.claim: Every retained operative step, nonoperative option, complication definition and functional outcome has complete primary-source verification
claimChecks.locator: Outstanding full papers, tables, figures and source packages
claimChecks.note: Obtain and inspect the complete primary packages before clinical clearance.
